title: Zara's funded PhD in the UK
caption: A funded PhD in the UK: full tuition + a maintenance stipend for up to 3.5 years 🇬🇧 Warwick's Chancellor's International Scholarship for 2027 entry, apply by 7 Dec 2026. Comment LINK 👇 #phd #warwick #scholarship #studyinuk #fullyfunded

scenes.backdrop: grand old British university library with arched windows and long wooden tables

beats.title: A FUNDED PhD IN THE UK?

beats.text: Quddus, a PhD in the UK costs more than my whole village's harvest.
beats.say: Kuddus, a P.H.D. in the U.K. costs more than my whole village's harvest.
Not with the Chancellor's International Scholarship at the University of Warwick.
Fees AND a stipend for three and a half years?

beats.text: For outstanding international PhD applicants. It's very competitive, so your application must shine.
beats.say: For outstanding international P.H.D. applicants. It's very competitive, so your application must shine.

scenes.backdrop: modern British university campus with glass buildings, green lawn and autumn trees

beats.text: First, find a Warwick PhD program and a supervisor. Then apply for the PhD and the scholarship before December seventh.
beats.say: First, find a Warwick P.H.D. program and a supervisor. Then apply for the P.H.D. and the scholarship before December seventh.
Does every department use the same date?
Check your department's page too. Some set their own earlier dates.
Supervisor search: activated. Warwick, I'm coming with my research proposal!
